ai_summary: Adroit Industries' Q1 2026 unaudited results show mixed revenue performance (standalone down, consolidated slightly up year-over-year) but improved profitability across both standalone and consolidated figures, largely due to effective expense management. The most significant red flag is the auditor's explicit note that all comparative financial information and certain foreign subsidiary data within the consolidated results were not subjected to their limited review. This lack of independent assurance on past periods and a portion of current consolidated figures warrants investor caution.
